brief: Citadel Securities (Scott Rubner) turns more constructive on US equities into Q4. Chain: September reset positioning and leverage, cooled retail, CTA selling, and compressed valuations, leaving the market cleaner entering Q4. That reset enables a reload: earnings return to focus, corporate buyback windows reopen (Oct 15), retail historically re-engages in October, and CTA positioning is now below neutral with room to rebuild. Separately, index strength masks breadth weakness: just 25% of S&P 500 names trade above their 50-day average and four mega-caps drove over 200% of Q3's index gain, even as corporate profits hit a record share of GDP and EPS estimates keep rising into Q3 earnings. Falling dispersion is expected to rise through Q4, shifting focus from index to stock-picking. Seasonality (midterm-year Q4 averages, October lows preceding year-end rallies) supports the call, but the note does not expect a straight line higher and recommends using October weakness to add to core longs, preferring single names where positioning has reset.
